Finish the offline Mac checks

Previous development renders and temporary files are cleaned. This minimal handoff is for the remaining clean-account installation, offline first use and restart checks. Nothing here marks those tests Passed.

1. Create the account

  1. Save other work. Open System Settings → Users & Groups → Add User. Create a Standard local account named CorridorKey QA. Enter its password and any administrator credentials locally; do not send them in chat.
  2. Keep networking on until the account and shared test folder are ready. Do not switch accounts yet if you need further guidance.

2. Go offline and install

  1. Turn Wi-Fi off, unplug Ethernet, and disconnect VPN/network adapters. Save a screenshot of the disabled network state. Leave networking disabled through the restart test.
  2. Log out of harvest and sign into CorridorKey QA. Do not install Python, pip, developer tools, a checkout or a model cache.
  3. In Finder press Command–Shift–G, enter /Users/Shared/CorridorKeyMac-0.9.7-Qualification, and open this page. The files and steps are available offline.
  4. Open CorridorKeyMac-0.9.7-beta.1-arm64-Offline.pkg in normal Installer. Approve the administrator prompt locally. Save its success screen into Test Results.

3. Make the first key

  1. Open Resolve Studio and create a separate project named CorridorKey Offline QA. Import BS_01.mp4 from this folder. This authorized clip is already 1920×1080. Use a 1920×1080, 25 fps timeline.
  2. Open Fusion, select MediaIn, press Shift–Space and search CorridorKey. Add CorridorKey2.0 hp beta. Confirm MediaIn → hp beta → MediaOut.
  3. Use Input Encoding sRGB, Mode Single Frame, Internal Resolution Full, Output Premultiplied, Despill Amount 0, and hints off. Do not open Manager before the first completed key.
  4. Wait for automatic preparation and a real frame. The airplane should remain and the blue backing should be removed. Inspect alpha and save a screenshot. No manual worker or model download should be needed.
  5. Export frames 0–5 through Deliver as EXR, RGBA float32, Export Alpha into Test Results/First Use. Leave Use render cached images off. Save the Completed render-queue screen.

4. Preserve proof and restart

  1. After first keying, open Applications → CorridorKey Mac Manager. Click GPU status. Preserve the diagnostic text or screenshots showing MPS, float32, fixture passed, completed user frames and network-stage counters. Click Verify and preserve its result too.
  2. Save the Resolve test project. Restart the Mac locally while still offline. Log back into CorridorKey QA.
  3. Reopen that saved project and request a new, previously unprocessed frame, such as frame 100. Verify the engine starts automatically and the key is correct. Export that frame into Test Results/After Restart, and preserve a viewer screenshot and GPU status.
  4. Save and close Resolve. Log back into harvest, restore networking, and resume this Codex task. Keep Test Results for inspection before the report is changed. The shared handoff will be removed after its evidence is retained.
